title: Gaussian torus Fourier representative
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\mu$ be a finite measure on $\mathbb R^n$, let $p\ge 1$ be an extended nonnegative real number, and let $m:(\mathrm{Fin}\,n\times\{0,1\})\to\mathbb Z$. The $L^p(\mu)$ function obtained by pulling back the torus Fourier character indexed by $m$ along the Gaussian torus map agrees $\mu$-almost everywhere with the function that evaluates that character at the image of each point under the map.
hypotheses_covered: $\mu$ is a finite measure on $\mathbb R^n$
